Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified John of Foix’s father as “Gaston II de Foix” based on a misleading search snippet and did not verify by opening authoritative sources. This led to the incorrect lineage (Gaston I → Gaston II → John → Germaine) and the wrong conclusion that Germaine’s paternal grandfather was Gaston I. In reality, John of Foix (1450–1500) was the son of Gaston IV, Count of Foix, making Gaston IV Germaine’s paternal grandfather.
